comparison: Not copied from the existing two catalog variants per language. These are new editorial prompts; do not report as a blind user sample after they have been examined.

records.en: Can people know many worldly things yet remain ignorant of Christian teaching?
records.fr: Peut-on être très cultivé et néanmoins ignorer la doctrine chrétienne ?

records.en: What obligation did Pius X place on parish priests regarding doctrinal teaching?
records.fr: Quel devoir Pie X confiait-il aux curés pour instruire les fidèles ?

records.en: Could the catechist improvise because his audience is poorly educated?
records.fr: Un catéchiste peut-il improviser devant des personnes peu instruites ?

records.en: If Baptism bestows faith, why do Christians still need to be taught?
records.fr: Si le baptême donne la foi, pourquoi faut-il encore enseigner les chrétiens ?

records.en: How did he connect religious education to restoring Christ's place in society?
records.fr: Quel rôle l'instruction de la foi joue-t-elle dans le retour au Christ ?

records.en: What part were ordinary believers supposed to play in the restoration of Christian life?
records.fr: Quelle place les simples fidèles occupaient-ils dans le renouveau chrétien ?

records.en: Can endless pastoral work substitute for a priest's personal virtues?
records.fr: Les activités du ministère suffisent-elles à la sainteté personnelle du prêtre ?

records.en: Does a cleric gain anything from reading holy books beyond his ordinary prayers?
records.fr: Pourquoi la lecture de livres saints compte-t-elle pour un prêtre qui prie déjà ?

records.en: Should a confessor also account for his own conduct at the end of the day?
records.fr: Le prêtre doit-il juger chaque soir ses propres paroles et actions ?

records.en: Did he want clergy to make yearly exercises of recollection?
records.fr: Conseillait-il au clergé des exercices spirituels chaque année ?

records.en: How did the Pope invoke the Heart of Jesus on behalf of his priests?
records.fr: Comment le pape invoquait-il le Cœur de Jésus pour le clergé ?
